equipment.name: Precision Cutting Machines
equipment.specifications: Allows users to cut a wide range of sample sizes and hardnesses. Different blade types available, adjustable cutting speed.

equipment.name: Mounting Presses
equipment.specifications: Two mounting presses available to embed samples in Bakelite and resin for SEM or other characterisation. High temperature and pressure system with automatic embedding methods.

equipment.name: Grinding and Polishing Equipment
equipment.specifications: Manual and automatic methods for grinding and polishing samples (mounted in resin or hand-held). Grinding papers and polishing pads of different varieties available.

equipment.name: Engraver
equipment.specifications: Used to mark and keep track of samples.

equipment.name: Ovens and Furnaces
equipment.specifications: Tube and muffle ovens/furnaces for heat treating samples from room temperature to 1600 °C.

equipment.name: X-ray Diffractometer (XRD)
equipment.specifications: Uses copper line focus X-ray tube with a nickel Kβ absorber (0.02 mm; Kβ = 1.392250 Å) producing Kα radiation (Kα1 = 1.540593 Å, Kα2 = 1.544426 Å, Kα ratio 0.5, Kαav = 1.541874 Å). Increment size 0.0149282, power setting 30.0 kV and 20 mA. Powder sample volume 66 or 266 mm3, non-powdered sample holder max 35 x 10 mm. Includes multichanger and Anton-Parr heating stage unit up to 500 °C. Exports to XML, ASC, RAW, XY.

equipment.name: X-ray Fluorescence Spectrometer (XRF)
equipment.specifications: Non-destructive technique using X-rays to determine chemical composition.

equipment.name: FTIR Spectrometer (Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy)
equipment.specifications: Non-destructive instrument using infrared light to measure infrared absorption and emission spectra.

equipment.name: Particle Size Analyzer (PSA)
equipment.specifications: Uses lasers to characterise size and shape distribution of particles in powders or liquid suspension. Installed with wet and dry methods.

equipment.name: Zeta Potential Analyzer
equipment.specifications: Non-destructive instrument used to measure electrical potentials at the slipping plane of particles in suspension.

equipment.name: Dilatometer
equipment.specifications: Precision instrument used to measure dimensional changes (thermal expansion or shrinkage) as a function of temperature.

equipment.name: STA (Simultaneous Thermal Analysis)
equipment.specifications: Simultaneously measures TGA (Thermogravimetry) and DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry). Equipped with an autochanger holding up to 20 samples.

equipment.name: DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry)
equipment.specifications: Measures heat flow of a sample over a temperature range using a reference. Equipped with an autochanger for up to 20 samples.

equipment.name: Optical Microscopes
equipment.specifications: Used for imaging samples, taking images, and taking measurements.

equipment.name: Keyence Digital Microscope (VHX-7000)
equipment.specifications: Magnification x6000, 2D & 3D imaging and measurements, joystick controller, auto focus.

equipment.name: Hitachi TM3030+ Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM)
equipment.specifications: Equipped with BSE (Back scattered electron) detector, SE (Secondary electron) detector, and EDX (energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy) detector for chemical composition measurement.

equipment.name: Hitachi TM4000+ Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM)
equipment.specifications: Equipped with BSE (Back scattered electron) detector, SE (Secondary electron) detector, and EDX (energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy) detector for chemical composition measurement.

equipment.name: Tensile Testing Instruments
equipment.specifications: Two instruments used for measuring tensile strength by applying force. Equipped with safety guards and touchscreen computer.

equipment.name: Struers Duramin-40 Hardness Tester
equipment.specifications: Used for measuring hardness of materials.
